text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The showdown set to cap off the year is approaching fast. After winning the Kikuka Sho, Super Creek declares herself the newest contender for the crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the pressure of the decisive race bearing down on her, Tamamo Cross's appetite starts to fade again. We take this to mean her body is prepping for the battle ahead…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if her portions get any smaller, she'll have no chance of winning against Oguri Cap. As a result of our search for another means of bulking up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to retire from the Twinkle Series at the end of the year. No longer worried about longevity, we put our all into grueling training for the high-stakes battle ahead.
